title: User sets notification preference to 'Email'
gherkin:
Feature: Notification Preference Enforcement
  Scenario: User sets notification preference to Email
    Given the user is logged in
    When the user navigates to notification settings
    And the user selects 'Email' as the notification preference
    Then the system should save the preference as 'Email'
rationale: To ensure that the system correctly saves the user's preference for receiving notifications via email.
generationSummary: This document outlines Gherkin test cases for the requirement of enforcing notification preferences in a software system.
